content: Confirmed via MaxMind's own dev.maxmind.com docs: GeoIP2 Anonymous IP database fields are is_anonymous, is_anonymous_vpn, is_hosting_provider, is_public_proxy, is_residential_proxy, is_tor_exit_node -- paid product, self-hosted mmdb, no per-lookup network call. Free open-source alternative: X4BNet/lists_vpn on GitHub, auto-rebuilt via GitHub Actions from ASN + netblock sources, ships plain IPv4/IPv6 CIDR text lists (output/vpn/ipv4.txt, output/datacenter/ipv4.txt) that can be periodically pulled out-of-band (same air-gapped-friendly pattern as the existing GeoLite2-City .mmdb supply) and loaded into an in-memory IP-range trie for O(log n) lookups.
